metadata.description:
Winding, quiet, and framed by some of the city’s most beautiful homes, Lake of the Isles feels like a secret garden with water in the middle. Its wooded banks, delicate footbridges, and graceful curves create a tranquil escape in the heart of the city. It’s where artists sketch, dogs roam, and canoes glide silently. Claim this Lake Lover POAP for wandering through Minneapolis’s most poetic waterscape in the 612 POAP Challenge. 

Category: Lake Lover 
GPS: 44.95472, -93.31198 
Map: https://www.google.com/maps/place/44.95472,-93.31198
